mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE 1 = 1 ) AS property_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status IN ('OWNER_OCCUPIED', 'TENANT_OCCUPIED') ) AS occupied_property_count, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu2 JOIN building_unit bu2 ON bu2.building_unit_id = pu2.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu2.building_id WHERE 1 = 1 ), 0) * 100, 2) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status IN ('OWNER_OCCUPIED', 'TENANT_OCCUPIED') ), 0) AS occupancy_rate_percent, COALESCE(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.received_amount), 0) AS received_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.outstanding_amount), 0) AS outstanding_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.received_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS collection_rate_percent FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE v.billing_year = #{year}

SELECT v.bill_id, pu.property_no, c.community_name, v.billing_year, v.billing_month, v.receivable_amount, v.received_amount, v.outstanding_amount, v.due_date FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id WHERE v.status = 'OVERDUE' ORDER BY v.outstanding_amount DESC, v.due_date ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL ) AS active_resident_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL AND r.residence_role = 'RESPONSIBLE' ) AS responsible_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'OWNER_OCCUPIED' ) AS owner_occupied_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'TENANT_OCCUPIED' ) AS tenant_occupied_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'AVAILABLE_FOR_RENT' ) AS available_for_rent_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status = 'VACANT' ) AS vacant_count, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit pu2 JOIN building_unit bu2 ON bu2.building_unit_id = pu2.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu2.building_id WHERE 1 = 1 ), 0) * 100, 2) FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.occupancy_status IN ('OWNER_OCCUPIED', 'TENANT_OCCUPIED') ), 0) AS occupancy_rate_percent

SELECT r.relation_to_responsible AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL GROUP BY r.relation_to_responsible ORDER BY value DESC, label

SELECT c.community_name AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id WHERE r.end_date IS NULL GROUP BY c.community_id, c.community_name ORDER BY value DESC, c.community_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rl.status = 'PUBLISHED'), 0) AS current_published_count, COALESCE(SUM(rl.status = 'RENTED' AND YEAR(rl.closed_at) = #{year}), 0) AS rented_in_period_count, COALESCE(SUM(rl.listing_mode = 'SELF'), 0) AS self_count, COALESCE(SUM(rl.listing_mode = 'AGENCY'), 0) AS agency_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rl.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN rl.monthly_rent END), 2), 0) AS average_monthly_rent, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rl.published_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN rl.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(rl.published_at)) ELSE DATEDIFF(DATE(COALESCE(rl.closed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)), DATE(rl.published_at)) END), 2), 0) AS average_listing_days FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT c.community_name AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.community_id, c.community_name ORDER BY value DESC, c.community_id

SELECT rl.listing_mode AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY rl.listing_mode ORDER BY rl.listing_mode

SELECT COALESCE(a.agency_name, '业主直租') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id LEFT JOIN authorization az ON az.authorization_id = rl.authorization_id AND az.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id LEFT JOIN agency a ON a.agency_id = az.agency_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(a.agency_name, '业主直租') ORDER BY value DESC, label

SELECT rl.status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM rental_listing rl JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = rl.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY rl.status ORDER BY rl.status
